items.title: Give Families a Window Into What Students Are Really Learning
items.contentSnippet: Report cards show what students earned. They rarely show what students care about, how they think, or what they can do. In this practical piece from PBLWorks leaders Ryan Sprott and Taya Tselolikhina, district leaders will find concrete strategies for making student learning visible to families through project-based work, student-led exhibitions, and authentic communication channels. It is a timely read for any leader looking to move family engagement from passive updates to genuine partnership.
